p.i: III. Ecclesiam non debere regi per tales Presbyteros, seu Seniores, quales hodie sunt in Reformatis Ecclesijs Belgicis, qui in verbo non laborant.

main_text.p: Ab HVG. GROTIO, Pietat. Ord. Holl. pag. 88. Presbyteri autem isti (ne quis antiquitatis magis quam moris nostri ignarus in eâ voce hallucinetur) non sunt qui verbum DEI prædicant, aut Sacramenta exhibent, sed pauci numero delecti ex populo, Pastorum συνέδροι[?], qui unâ cum Pastoribus Ecclesiam regunt. Ibidem. pag. 112. Pastores ac Presbyteri ipsi debebunt saltem συνέδρους[?] illos suos, quos Presbyteros vocant, utpote suum εὔχημα, eligere.
main_text.head: ARTICULUS XXXI. De vocatione Ministrorum Ecclesiæ.
main_text.p: CRedimus Ministros, Seniores, & Diaconos debere ad functiones illas suas vocari & promoveri legitimâ Ecclesiæ vocatione 1. adhibita ad eam seriâ DEI invocatione, [atque adhibitis Ecclesiæ suffragijs, ac postea confirmari in muneribus suis per impositionem manuū ] eo ordine & modo, qui nobis in verbo DEI præscribitur. page.notes: The first Greek word (συνέδροι) and the second (συνέδρους) are hard to read at this scan resolution; both are marked [?]. The Greek εὔχημα is printed with breathing and accent marks, transcribed as seen. The "D'EI" forms are printed DEI with a small mark above the E, not transcribed. The "1." after "vocatione" is printed in the text and kept as it stands. The square brackets around "atque ... manuū ]" are printed as they stand, with the closing bracket after "manuū". The catchword "citis" lies at the lower right and is not repeated in the text; the text ends on the hyphenated "illi-" as printed.
